description: This file defines Romanian (Romania) culture-specific date and time formatting patterns, locale-specific names for days and months, and parsing functions for dates in the Romanian language. It appears to be part of a larger date handling library, likely Datejs, tailored for the Romanian locale.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a Date object to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the Date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current Date object.
